Job description:
We are looking for a Senior Network Security Engineer with experience in designing, implementing, and managing network security infrastructures at the Enterprise scale. This position will be responsible for designing and executing security solutions, managing next-generation firewalls, and implementing security policies. Responsibilities include designing and implementing network security architecture, managing NGFW equipment, designing and implementing VPNs, designing High Availability, troubleshooting security issues, implementing Zero Trust and Network Segmentation, and preparing technical documentation for security equipment such as Cisco Secure Firewall (FTD), Cisco Firepower Management Center (FMC), Cisco ASA, Palo Alto NGFW Panorama, GlobalProtect, Fortinet FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiWeb, Juniper SRX Series Firewall, Security Technologies IPS / IDS WAF SSL Inspection DPI Threat Prevention Application Control URL Filtering NAT ACL Site-to-Site VPN Remote Access VPN IPsec VPN SSL VPN GRE Tunnel DMVPN High Availability (HA). Preferred qualifications include Cisco ISE, Cisco TrustSec, Cisco DNA Center, CCNP Security, CCIE Security, PCNSE, Fortinet FCP / FCSS, or JNCIS-SEC or JNCIP-SEC.

Company description:
The group operates in the field of IT, including various network services and network security, the production and sale of various software, portals, and other diverse services in this area. This company has been able to be a leader in the IT arena at the country level by relying on up-to-date knowledge and experienced personnel.
